description: Defines an abstract class YAxisRenderer for rendering Y axes in charts, including methods for calculating axis scales and tick labels.

classes.name: YAxisRenderer
classes.description: Base class for Y axis rendering in charting, providing scale and tick calculations.

methods.name: FineTuneYAxis
methods.description: Calculates optimal axis scale and tick marks based on yMin and yMax values.

methods.name: GetDefaultTickLabelsFormat
methods.description: Returns default format string for axis tick labels.
